title: Sprong - Location & Why to Beat It First
description: Sprong is an optional boss north of the Endless Tower in Expedition 33, and it drops the Cheater Pictos - the single best reason to beat it first.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sprong is an optional boss on The Continent, and among the Act 3 overworld bosses it is the one you should fight first - not because it is the easiest, but because of what it drops.

sections.title: Where to Find Sprong
sections.content:
Location: The Continent, partially submerged in the ocean just north of the Endless Tower.

It is hard to miss once you are in the area - look for the large shape sitting in the water.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
Sprong has no documented elemental weakness or resistance - there is no elemental key to this fight.

That makes it a pure execution check: a large health pool, a predictable attack pattern, and counterattacks doing the heavy lifting. Parrying is the real damage source here, not element choice.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Cheater Pictos - lets an equipped character act twice in a row on their turn
  • The "Sprong" achievement

Cheater is one of the strongest Pictos in the game. An extra action per turn compounds with everything else in your build, which is why killing Sprong early makes every other optional boss easier.

sections.title: How to Beat Sprong
sections.content:
Sprong has a large health pool but a predictable attack pattern with strikes that are comparatively easy to counter by the standards of late-game optional bosses.

As long as you can withstand and counter its heavier hits, it should not give you much trouble. Parrying does the heavy lifting here - counters ignore the long health bar problem by giving you consistent, resource-free damage.

Treat it as the opening move of your Act 3 boss tour: kill Sprong, equip Cheater, then use the extra action to make the rest of the list manageable.
